hooks.command: branch=$(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null); changes=$(git status --porcelain 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' '); echo "Branch: $branch | $changes uncommitted files"

jq -r '(.prompt // .user_prompt // "")' | { p=$(cat); echo "$p" | grep -qiE '(implement|build|add|create).{0,30}(feature|endpoint|module|page|component|story)|implement[[:space:]]+US-' && echo 'Use /implement for the full feature workflow, or /review before committing.'; true; }

jq -r '(.prompt // .user_prompt // "")' | { p=$(cat); phase=$(.claude/project/workflow-state.sh get-field phase 2>/dev/null || echo none); if [ "$phase" = "plan_created" ] && echo "$p" | grep -qiE '(approve[d]?|lgtm|looks good|go ahead|proceed|ship it|^(y|yes|yep|yeah)$|yes.*(plan|proceed|implement))'; then .claude/project/workflow-state.sh advance plan_approved 2>/dev/null; .claude/project/workflow-state.sh next-action 2>/dev/null; fi; true; }

jq -r '.tool_input.command' | { cmd=$(cat); if echo "$cmd" | grep -qE 'git push .*(-f|--force)'; then echo 'BLOCKED: git push --force is forbidden. Use regular git push.'; exit 2; fi; if echo "$cmd" | grep -qE 'git reset --hard'; then echo 'BLOCKED: git reset --hard is forbidden. Use git stash or backup branch.'; exit 2; fi; if echo "$cmd" | grep -qE 'git (checkout|restore) (-- )?\.'; then echo 'BLOCKED: Discarding all changes is forbidden. Be selective.'; exit 2; fi; if echo "$cmd" | grep -qE 'git clean .*-f'; then echo 'BLOCKED: git clean -f is forbidden. Use git stash.'; exit 2; fi; if echo "$cmd" | grep -qE 'git branch -D'; then echo 'BLOCKED: git branch -D is forbidden. Use -d for safe delete.'; exit 2; fi; if echo "$cmd" | grep -qE '\-\-no-verify'; then echo 'BLOCKED: --no-verify is forbidden. Fix failing hooks instead of bypassing.'; exit 2; fi; }

jq -r '.tool_input.command' | { cmd=$(cat); if echo "$cmd" | grep -qE '^git commit'; then story=$(.claude/project/workflow-state.sh get-field activeStory 2>/dev/null || echo none); if [ "$story" != "none" ] && [ "$story" != "null" ]; then phase=$(.claude/project/workflow-state.sh get-field phase 2>/dev/null || echo none); case "$phase" in implementation_in_progress) echo 'COMMIT GATE: Run /review before committing. Review has not been run yet.'; exit 2;; under_review) echo 'COMMIT GATE: Review is in progress. Wait for review to complete.'; exit 2;; changes_requested) findings=$(.claude/project/workflow-state.sh get-field 'reviewFindings | length' 2>/dev/null || echo 0); echo "COMMIT GATE: Review found $findings blocker(s). Fix all issues and run /review again."; exit 2;; esac; fi; fi; true; }

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path' | { read f; case "$f" in *.env.example|*.env.sample|*.env.template) ;; *.env|*.env.*|*credentials.json|*.pem|*.key|*.p12|*.pfx) echo 'BLOCKED: Cannot edit secrets/credentials file directly. Ask the user for explicit confirmation.'; exit 2 ;; esac; }

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path' | { read f; case "$f" in */src/*) phase=$(.claude/project/workflow-state.sh get-field phase 2>/dev/null || echo none); story=$(.claude/project/workflow-state.sh get-field activeStory 2>/dev/null || echo none); if [ "$story" != "none" ] && [ "$story" != "null" ]; then case "$phase" in discovery_started|discovery_complete|plan_created) echo "WORKFLOW GATE: Editing source for $story but plan not yet approved (phase: $phase). Get plan approval first.";; under_review) echo "WORKFLOW GATE: Review is in progress for $story. Wait for review to complete before editing source files.";; esac; fi;; esac; true; }

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path' | { read f; case "$f" in *.js|*.ts|*.jsx|*.tsx|*.json|*.css|*.html|*.md) npx prettier --write "$f" 2>/dev/null ;; *.py) black "$f" 2>/dev/null ;; *.rs) rustfmt "$f" 2>/dev/null ;; esac; }

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path' | { read f; case "$f" in *.ts|*.tsx) dir="$f"; while [ "$dir" != "/" ] && [ "$dir" != "." ]; do dir=$(dirname "$dir"); if [ -f "$dir/tsconfig.json" ]; then cd "$dir" && npx tsc --noEmit --pretty 2>&1 | head -20; break; fi; done ;; esac; }

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path' | { read f; WF=.claude/project/workflow-state.sh; case "$f" in */.claude/project/features/us-*) story=$(echo "$f" | grep -oE '[Uu][Ss]-[0-9]+' | head -1 | tr '[:lower:]' '[:upper:]'); current=$($WF get-field activeStory 2>/dev/null || echo none); if [ "$current" = "none" ] || [ "$current" = "null" ]; then title=$(basename "$f" .md | sed 's/^us-[0-9]*-//;s/-/ /g'); $WF start "$story" "$title" 2>/dev/null; fi; $WF advance discovery_complete 2>/dev/null;; */.claude/project/plans/us-*) current_phase=$($WF get-field phase 2>/dev/null || echo none); if [ "$current_phase" = "none" ] || [ "$current_phase" = "discovery_started" ]; then echo 'WORKFLOW GATE: Writing plan but no feature spec exists yet. Create the story file in .claude/project/features/ first (Phase 0e of /implement).'; fi; $WF advance discovery_complete 2>/dev/null; $WF advance plan_created 2>/dev/null;; esac; true; }

jq -r '.tool_input.command' | { cmd=$(cat); if echo "$cmd" | grep -qE '^git commit'; then story=$(.claude/project/workflow-state.sh get-field activeStory 2>/dev/null || echo none); if [ "$story" != "none" ] && [ "$story" != "null" ]; then phase=$(.claude/project/workflow-state.sh get-field phase 2>/dev/null || echo none); if [ "$phase" = "review_passed" ]; then .claude/project/workflow-state.sh advance complete 2>/dev/null; echo "WORKFLOW: $story committed and complete! Run .claude/project/workflow-state.sh clear when ready for next story."; fi; fi; fi; true; }
git diff --quiet 2>/dev/null && git diff --cached --quiet 2>/dev/null || echo 'UNCOMMITTED CHANGES: Before committing, run your verification checklist (tests, lint, type checking).'
